coverage.notes: The 2026 central official English-taught undergraduate list contains five verified, direct-entry programmes, all described here. This is historical programme scope, NOT a confirmed exhaustive 2027 list. ZJUI lists four 2025 international dual engineering degrees and two 2025 single engineering degrees on separate pages, omitted from the 2026 central catalogue; eligibility for first-year international applicants in 2027 is unresolved, so these are documented as a scope gap rather than silently included or declared unavailable. Main university Chinese-taught degrees are outside the English-language scope. 2027 application deadlines, academic-year fees, capacity and admission cutoffs are not verified.

institution.summary: Hangzhou-based comprehensive research university; English-taught international first degrees at Haining and Yiwu.

programmes.name: Clinical Medicine (MBBS)
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS)
programmes.campus: International School of Medicine, Yiwu, Zhejiang
programmes.language: English (with Chinese language training for clinical work)
programmes.about: A six-year medical first degree in Yiwu combining biomedical foundations with clinical training and supervised hospital experience.
programmes.overview: Students begin with subjects such as biological science, anatomy, chemistry, physics and mathematics for medicine, then progress through medical sciences and clinical subjects. The school publishes laboratory teaching, early clinical exposure and hospital-based placements as parts of the route. Chinese and Medical Chinese are included to prepare students to communicate during clinical attachments in Chinese hospitals. This is a direct-entry medical degree rather than a postgraduate medicine programme.

programmes.name: Biomedical Engineering
programmes.campus: International School of Medicine, Yiwu, Zhejiang
programmes.about: A four-year, English-taught biomedical engineering first degree offered by Zhejiang University at its Yiwu International School of Medicine.
programmes.overview: Zhejiang University lists Biomedical Engineering among its English-taught first degrees at the International School of Medicine in Yiwu. The field typically combines engineering, quantitative science and biological or medical problems, including technologies used in healthcare. ZJU research elsewhere in biomedical engineering includes sensing and medical instrumentation; this does not establish the modules taught at Yiwu. The separate Yiwu course plan could not be checked from the large official admissions brochure, so specialist tracks and learning methods remain unverified.

programmes.name: Communication (Global Communication and Management)
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Arts in Global Communication and Management
programmes.about: A four-year interdisciplinary BA connecting business and management studies with communication, international contexts and contemporary China.
programmes.overview: The programme combines management, finance, accounting and economics with communication practice and understanding of contemporary China. Students connect academic learning with case studies, projects and internships, developing cross-cultural communication and analytical skills. An academic dissertation provides an opportunity to investigate a chosen subject. The International Business School describes the degree as full-time, taught in English and normally admitting a new cohort in September.

programmes.name: Integrative Biomedical Sciences (Dual Degree)
programmes.credential: Dual bachelor's degrees (Zhejiang University and University of Edinburgh)
programmes.about: A joint Zhejiang–Edinburgh biomedical sciences degree examining human health and disease through biology, physiology and experimental research.
programmes.overview: The programme studies biomedical mechanisms from molecules and cells to human organ systems, building foundations in genetics, physiology and laboratory investigation. Later study offers areas including neuroscience, infection, pharmacology and immunology, alongside scientific inquiry and critical evaluation of research. Practical and research-based learning develops experimental and communication skills. Successful students meeting both universities' requirements receive bachelor's degrees from Zhejiang University and the University of Edinburgh.

programmes.name: Biomedical Informatics (Dual Degree)
programmes.credential: Dual bachelor's degrees (Zhejiang University and University of Edinburgh)
programmes.about: A joint Zhejiang–Edinburgh degree combining biomedical sciences with programming, statistics and computational analysis of biological data.
programmes.overview: Students study cellular and molecular biology and human physiology while developing programming and data-handling skills relevant to medicine. The curriculum describes Python, computing systems, databases, statistical methods, genomics and biomedical data analysis, including work with research datasets. Laboratory and group work are integrated with research training, culminating in a biomedical informatics project and dissertation. The dual-degree structure leads to awards from Zhejiang University and the University of Edinburgh when both sets of requirements are fulfilled.
